_meta.description: Hand-graded calibration set for the Apply-It Workbench Sonnet evaluator. Each case's `expected` per-dimension scores (integers 0-5) are author-graded against the few-shot anchors in lib/workbench/evaluator-exemplars.ts (absent dimension ~= 1, excellent ~= 5). The live harness (evaluator-calibration.live.test.ts) runs each case through the real evaluateAttempt() and asserts the mean absolute deviation from these baselines stays within the drift budget, per dimension. Run with `pnpm test:eval` before any evaluator-model bump or prompt change. See docs/plans/2026-05-27-apply-it-workbench-v1.md (Evaluator engineering plan).

cases.brief: Draft launch announcement copy for PennyWise, a new mobile budgeting app aimed at first-time savers.
cases.expert_prompt: You are a consumer fintech copywriter. In under 100 words, write a launch announcement for 'PennyWise', a budgeting app for first-time savers aged 20-30 who feel anxious about money. Warm, encouraging tone; no finance jargon. Return a headline plus exactly two short paragraphs.

Money, finally on your side.

PennyWise is for anyone who has ever felt a knot in their stomach opening a banking app. We turn saving into small, doable steps you can actually stick to.

No spreadsheets, no lectures. Just gentle nudges that help your balance grow while you get on with your life. Your first win is closer than you think.

Hi Maria, thank you for your patience while we sorted out the billing issue.
